title: Review post-measurement equipment authority
description:
Make a human post-measurement authorization disposition for each exact configuration using grant research and rf.05/rf.06 evidence. Determine whether current evidence supports allowed, disallowed or unverified operation and identify any further filing or reviewer evidence needed. This is not the earlier test-session clearance.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: No external action occurs here. A selected filing is separately deferred authority.13. New grant or waveform evidence requires human re-review; closing a decision is not affirmative authorization. Depend on measurement leaves, never the entire RF parent, to avoid a parent-level cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Record a source-backed allowed, disallowed or unverified equipment-authority disposition, the precise configuration and unresolved conditions. Disallowed, unverified and no-go reviews are valid outcomes; missing measurements or required authority cannot be a pass. A favorable review is not execution permission. For any positive approval of a subsequent action: Require recorded, scoped, explicit approval from Mark for the named action. That approval cannot substitute for regulatory evidence. No automatic filing or baseline activation follows, and optional contact work is not required to record no-go.
